central_open_loop: What recorded a metallic 38-Hertz acoustic signal 36,000 feet beneath the Pacific Ocean?

scenes.narration: Thirty-six thousand feet beneath the Pacific, inside the pitch-black abyss of Challenger Deep, titanium hydrophones recorded a sound that oceanographers cannot explain.
